checks.label: Energy balance (deposited = stored + rejected, from the outputs)
checks.note: largest relative gap over the outputs; threshold 3% of the energy deposited so far. Energies are the nominal sphere's (the wedge's divided by 0.999087). The heat made is that of the implicit step (the source at the end of each step, which is how OFFBEAT and the independent solution deposit it; the integral of the table is in the record as "deposited"), and the heat leaving is a trapezoid over the output times, which is poor when the outputs are far apart compared with the time the heat takes to leave: add outputs

checks.label: OFFBEAT vs the independent finite-volume solution (max cell deviation)
checks.note: largest at t = 0.020000000000000014 s; bound 0.107 K = min(3 x 0.042 K [the independent solution's own change when its cells are halved], 0.5% of the peak rise) + 0.02 K

checks.label: Time-stepping error of the peak temperature (step vs half step)
checks.note: the peak changes by at most 0.208 K, at any step of the run, when the step is halved; threshold 2% of the peak rise (0.35 K). If it fails, shorten the time step

checks.label: Property laws within their stated ranges
checks.note: all cell temperatures inside the stated ranges at every output and at every step of the independent solution

thermalOnly: Thermal-only result. It says nothing about stress, failure or fuel integrity. For a coated particle: the temperatures of the kernel and the layers, not the stress in the silicon carbide, the swelling and creep of the carbon, the gas pressure or a failure fraction.
